MHCC Tuesday Evening River Ride

Rotterdam, NY · Road

MHCC Tuesday Evening River Ride is a road group ride in Rotterdam, NY. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:30 pm from Kiwanis Park.

Next ride Tue, Oct 6, 6:30 PM EDT

Checked Oct 1, 2026. Confirmed against the sources at the foot of this page. Check the host's page before you go

How we know

MHCC's public ride schedule lists 'Tuesday Evening River Ride - Lock 8' for Tue Oct 6, 2026 at 6:30 PM (Tour/14 pace, 23.8 miles, lights recommended, sunset 6:30), described as a weekly ride series along the Mohawk River; no Tuesday rides are posted after Oct 6 yet.

When
Every Tuesday, 6:30 pmTuesdays, 6:30 pm, a weekly series along the Mohawk River. The Oct 6 ride is 'Lock 8' (23.8 miles). Nothing is posted after Oct 6 yet, so the series may be ending for the season.

For visitors

The ride leader gives the exact start and the route to non-members who use 'Contact Leader' on the ride listing. Non-members get one free ride, then club dues are $20 a year. Bring lights: the Oct 6 ride finishes after sunset.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: tour pace.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the MHCC Tuesday Evening River Ride group ride

A Tuesday evening club ride along the Mohawk from Kiwanis Park, west of Schenectady. Tour pace, member-led. The Capital Region club posts its public ride schedule online; non-members get one free ride before joining.
